title: driver-tariff.v1
description: One version of an emob tariff as a seller imports it: served by tarifd at /v1/driver-tariffs/{id} (the version in force) and /v1/driver-tariffs/{id}/{version} (that version while retained in history). Public; nothing about any customer.

id.description: The tariff's id, stable across versions.

version.description: The version: SHA-256 over everything that can change a price.

preisstand.description: The code a driver compares on the price page, the station's display and the receipt: the version's first four hex characters.

valid_from.description: In force from, inclusive; null when it has always been.

valid_until.description: In force until, exclusive; null while no later version is announced.

price.description: Exactly as the tariff states it; never a float.

display.description: What a driver must be shown, in AFIR Art. 5(4)'s order.

total.description: Rated by the function that bills, rounded as an invoice line is.

tariff.description: The tariff as emob-tariff serialises it: what a price check recomputes a session with.
